summary.text: Kym Taylor is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 23, where she has served since January 11, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. She is a business owner.

paragraphs.text: Taylor was born in Washington, D.C.
She earned a bachelor's degree from George Washington University in 1986 and a graduate degree from Atlanta University in 1988.
Her career experience includes owning Family Choice Healthcare and working as a legislative aide in the Maryland State Senate.

Ballotpedia lists her affiliations as including Alpha Kappa Alpha Sorority, Inc., The Links, Inc., the Prince George's County Chamber of Commerce, and the Prince George's County Advisory Committee on Aging.
For 2025-2026 she is assigned to the Judiciary Committee.
